purpose: isolated World-R1 HPSv2 and DA3/Qwen reward-server validation

packages.nvidia-cuda-nvcc-cu12: 12.8.93 (Linux wheel contains ptxas but no nvcc executable)

compatibility_notes: World-R1 imports moviepy.editor, which is absent from MoviePy 2.x; the isolated reward environment was pinned to moviepy==1.0.3.
HPSv2 1.2.0 omitted bpe_simple_vocab_16e6.txt.gz from its wheel; the exact official vocabulary was added only inside this isolated environment.
gsplat 1.5.3 JIT requires a real nvcc; the NVIDIA PyPI Linux wheel did not provide that executable, so a separate user-owned CUDA 12.8.61 Conda prefix was used.
The Conda CUDA headers live under targets/x86_64-linux/include; CPATH and matching library paths plus TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0 were required for the RTX 5090 build.
The flow_grpo conda environment, system Python, and other users' environments were not changed.
